title: How Broom Road took shape
description: A narrated replay of saved experiments, not a recording of agent reasoning or every optimiser step. Playback timing is editorial. The final model is only partially validated.

events.label: Locate
events.title: Start with the property, not the roof
events.text: The aerial and OS outline establish the property and its context. The white building outline and cyan site extent describe different things; neither is a room boundary.

events.label: Hypothesise
events.title: Turn the plan into a first house hypothesis
events.text: Printed plan dimensions anchor a parametric shell. Vertical walls and simple roof planes reduce the unknowns. This first recorded model still contains the wrong rear roof form.

events.label: Compare
events.title: Project the first model into a listing photo
events.text: Gold edges are the model projected through the fitted camera. Cyan points are labelled photo observations. The red connectors reveal the disagreement before refinement.

events.label: Fit front
events.title: Adjust the bay, openings and camera together
events.text: The front fitting error falls as dimensions and camera parameters change. The faint previous shape shows what moved. This is the saved result of the fit, not synthetic intermediate solver steps.

events.label: Check
events.title: A good fitting photo is not enough
events.text: A separate photo tests window positions excluded from fitting. Green points expose the remaining mismatch. These checks were inspected during development; they are not an untouched benchmark.

events.label: Add DSM
events.title: Use height samples where they support a plane
events.text: Cyan 3D points show the original DSM over the roofs. Broad slopes gain height constraints, but noisy edges and small faces cannot establish detailed roof geometry.

events.label: Challenge
events.title: The rear photo contradicts the roof hypothesis
events.text: The first pass gave the upper rear wing two slopes. The user identified both rear extensions as mono-pitch in this photo. No calibrated rear projection is available for this stage.

events.label: Revise roof
events.title: Change the rear form; preserve the front fit
events.text: The wing becomes mono-pitch. Yet its provisional camera reaches the field-of-view limit and the excluded corner still misses. A subsequent rear trial was rejected; its geometry was not adopted.

events.label: Inspect depth
events.title: Depth adds a view of relative separation
events.text: Blend the predicted depth with the photo and projected edges to inspect overlap and foreground separation. These values are relative log depth, not metres. Depth did not drive any recorded geometry update.

events.label: Inspect normals
events.title: Use surface direction to challenge the camera fit
events.text: Normal colours encode surface direction. The purple brick patch supplies one weak orientation constraint in the next experiment. Correlated pixels do not count as independent measurements.

events.label: Refine rear
events.title: Fit the lower roof and sloping glazed frame
events.text: Two rear photos and two weak normal constraints guide the lower extension. Its low edge drops and its rise increases. The front and upper wing stay frozen; dashed edges remain unvalidated context.

events.label: Check rear
events.title: Test the revision in the other rear photo
events.text: Excluded frame and fascia points now agree more closely. Switch to normals to inspect the second patch. This supports the visible lower extension, not the hidden upper wing or surveyed dimensions.

events.label: Complete windows
events.title: Recover the rear windows from visible photo edges
events.text: Two recessed windows were missing; the rear-wing sash was too wide. Gold regions trace visible frames, even where partly obscured. The corrected shapes use provisional dimensions. Purple projections expose the remaining upper-wall alignment problem; lower-door checks do not validate these windows.

events.label: Handover
events.title: A useful remote model, with questions still open
events.text: The working candidate now includes the photo-observed rear windows. Front and lower-extension fits are unchanged. Upper-wall alignment, hidden window extents, basement depth and metric dimensions remain open checks for the next geometry pass and survey.
